_meta.purpose: Government figures used to estimate what each kind of store in Niagara Falls actually sells, so the simulation can be calibrated to them.
_meta.method: City sales for a store type = (Ontario sales / Ontario employees in that store type) x employees of that store type in Niagara Falls. City employees come from the business register's size bands (data/business_revenue_benchmarks.csv) at the midpoint of each band.

sources.retail_sales: Statistics Canada table 20-10-0056-01, retail trade sales by province and industry, Ontario, unadjusted, sum of the 12 months of 2025 ($ thousands)
sources.food_services_sales: Statistics Canada monthly survey of food services and drinking places, Ontario 2025 (from behaviour_parameters.json: ontario_totals_2025)
sources.employment: Statistics Canada table 14-10-0202-01, employment by industry, annual, Ontario 2025, all employees
sources.gasoline: Statistics Canada table 23-10-0066-01, net sales of gasoline, Ontario 2025 (thousand litres)

_meta.seed: The 100+ band has no upper limit; 150 employees is an assumption. Store types with many 100+ firms (hotels, casinos) are reported but not used for calibration.
